notes.title: 05.24.2025 Update New Content
notes.notes:
-New large scene, factory

-A total of 17 new costumes, 10 costumes in Millie's store, 7 new scene costume gift boxes (including color change)

-Fixed the problem that sometimes you can't search or jump, you can only re-enter the game or switch scenes.

-Backpack costumes added classification function

-Optimized the shelter level selection interface

Because I've been testing the new game "Dawn Break" recently, the update is a bit slow.
The Dawn Break Demo will be available for trial in the near future. If you are interested, you can add it to your wishlist first!

notes.title: 05.17.2025 Update Fix
notes.notes:
-Removed some decorate.

notes.title: 29.01.2025--Chinese New Year Update Content
notes.notes:
It is recommended to manually back up the archive before updating! Happy Chinese New Year!

notes.title: 05.19.2024--Update content
notes.notes:
-- Modified the left rotation animation

notes.title: 04.29.2024-- Update fix
notes.notes:
-- Fixed that collecting iron blocks could not be completed
- Fixed weapon upgrade interface, the gamepad could not select the second row of weapons
- The exclamation point in the scene is changed to: the closer the player is, the bigger it is

notes.title: 04.07.2024-- Update the optimized content
notes.notes:
-- Add a strip button in the upper left corner of the backpack to remove each part of the outfit individually (no more pressing the default dress button every time)
--After unlocking the weapon accessories area, you can now wait to cool down and refill all weapons in your backpack at once.
-- Fix feet not working properly after clicking default dress up
-- Adjust the lower limit of mouse sensitivity, can now be adjusted more slowly
-- Kills now have a probability of gaining currency
-- The shelter bunny merchant adds a pair of heels
-- Added jumping landing footsteps, walking footsteps repair

notes.title: 2024.03.20 Optimization update
notes.notes:

notes.title: 2024.03.17--update content
notes.notes:
--Add cloud archive
--You can now cook "Sleep Cake" (use it on your partner. After using it, your partner will go to sleep and you can enter her dreamland)

--Fixed the bug where the crawler got stuck in the ammunition box
